answer: A beacon-decay bond stops fakes: each identity stakes 70 and must forge one walnut deed per key. Each epoch the beacon flashes a signal naming a random quarter; the called agent answers in ten minutes with fresh key-sealed work; a rented proof burns the bond. A miss decays the bond by 18; four misses expel it. 1,000 fakes pay 95,000: 70 bond and 25 proof each, losing 55,000 on a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 25 once, keeps its bond.
